record.description_evidence:
Snapply is a highly intelligent AI driven app to translate any form or language to another. Translate texts, speeches, images to any language you will. You can easily translate, detect objects, recognize celebrities or scan any text on images with one tap.


OBJECT RECOGNITION
Want to find where to buy cool things right away? Try object recognition out! You just take a photo of it and let Snapply do the rest. Snapply uses improved AI algorithm background to find what it is exactly. You can find which book is, which shoes they are wearing or what brand it is or simply to learn what it is. Menus, books, street signs etc, take photos and get translation in seconds.


SPEECH TO TEXT
You can also read the text by speech to text. Beside that you can simply speak to your phone and let Snapply translate it for you instantly. It provides you real time two-way speech translation and makes communication easier for you.
Snapply is a simple to use app for dictating text in all languages you want.


TEXT TO SPEECH
You can even learn how to pronounce any translated text with a text to speech feature easily. Text to speech conversion. You have Play and Stop options so you can listen to it repeatedly and change text sizes as you wish. You don’t have to type all the time, you can just send texts directly from any browser or other applications.
Snapply supports all TTS languages.


TEXT TRANSLATOR
You can simply translate text into any language you want. You can text, you can upload a photo of it or you can just say it.
Try an image to text feature by simply taking pictures of texts. You can translate texts in image by taking photos or just select from the album.


CELEBRITY RECOGNITION
You can use celebrity recognition to try celebrity lookalike or celebrity matching options in seconds. Edit your photos or stories, any content like superstars! Just take a photo of him/her or upload any picture from your phone and let the Snapply do the job.


SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
We offer automatic renewal subscription options:
- Weekly subscription 5.99$ with a 3-day free trial: unlock all features
- Annual subscription 39.99$: unlock all features
The price could vary with different country or region.


About Subscription:
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be provided.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user's Account Settings after purchase.

Break language barriers with a voice translator enhanced by artificial intelligence. Translate voice, text, images, and even objects — all in one place. Whether you're traveling, studying, or chatting with foreigners, this tool helps you communicate clearly and naturally in over 150 languages.

Key Features:
- AI Translation with customizable models
- Voice Translator
- Camera Translator (OCR)
- Object Recognition and Translation
- Typed Text Translator
- Built-in Dictionary and Word Learning
- Supports 150+ Languages

AI Translation
The app uses advanced AI models to provide accurate, natural translations. You can even select the AI model that best fits your situation — whether for casual conversations or professional use. The AI adapts to context and tone, making translations smarter than ever before.

Voice Translator
Speak and instantly get translations in another language. Ideal for live conversations, interviews, or asking for directions — no need to type anything. The app listens and speaks for you, allowing seamless communication with anyone.

Camera Translator (OCR)

Object Recognition and Translation
Not just words — the app can identify and translate objects too. Whether it’s a food item, a product label, or a symbol, it helps you understand your surroundings with ease.

Text Input Translator
Type or paste any phrase to get quick, reliable translations. Perfect for translating longer messages, reading content, or writing in another language with confidence.

Dictionary Mode
Explore multiple meanings, synonyms, and examples for each word. Great for language learners — use it to build vocabulary and practice using new words in context.

150+ Supported Languages
From global languages like English, Spanish, and Chinese to regional dialects and rare tongues — this app supports more than 150 languages for both input and output.

Download AI Voice Translator Language for iOS now!

Lorqa is an AI-native translation and real-time subtitles app for iOS and macOS.

It makes text conversion focused and efficient—large language models run locally on your device to translate text between languages accurately and naturally. My Journey

Translation is a very common need, and a variety of translation apps keep appearing on the market. Many large companies have entered this space, so there are numerous translation solutions. For a long time I used one particular translation tool daily — it was convenient: select text, press a hotkey, and the translation was done. But there were small annoyances during use, such as slow translation speed, limits on the amount of text that could be translated, and the need to use other methods for very long texts.

I’ve noticed that LLMs (large language models) are often used as translation tools now. LLMs have strong multilingual capabilities, and smaller models like Qwen3 and Gemma3 also provide very good translation quality. When using LLMs for translation there are many options: most are web-based, while some models are deployed locally. These products generally haven’t delivered a true end-to-end translation experience tailored to the use case — they often fall short.

I previously worked on PocketLM (a mobile LLM local inference client), so I have a good understanding of the capabilities of small LLMs and am familiar with inference and load times across different devices. That prompted me to start building an end-to-end translation app using LLMs. The implementation went fairly smoothly; in testing I found that Qwen3 0.6B 4-bit already performs on par with DeepL’s translation ability. I also added Qwen3 1.7B and the Gemma3 series as alternatives to give users multiple choices.

My motivation for making this product is quite personal. I’m curious whether this need exists for others as well, and I’d love to hear feedback on future plans.

OFFLINE TRANSLATOR

STAY ORGANIZED

Perfect for travel, communication, school work, and everyday conversations.

record.description_evidence:
Need a translation fast? Open the app, talk normally, or point your camera at the words you are stuck on and let it sort things out. The translation appears quickly and is easy to use right away. Use it when timing matters and respond with confidence!

Some moments are small but important. A quick reply, a label on a package, a sentence you do not fully understand. The app helps you clear that up without turning it into a process. Use it casually, like you would any everyday tool!

How It Works

• Pick your mode: voice, text, camera, or photo
• Select the languages or use automatic detection
• Speak, type, or scan what you want translated
• Read the translation and listen to pronunciation
• Continue the exchange smoothly in real time

No complicated setup. Just tap and go.

Live Conversation

When two people are speaking and neither shares the same language, rhythm matters. You say a sentence, the translation shows up, and the other person can answer without waiting too long. It keeps the exchange from turning awkward in those small but important moments.

Voice Translation

Instead of typing, just speak and let the words appear on screen. Play the audio back if you want to check how it should sound before saying it yourself. It fits those moments when stopping to type would slow everything down.

Camera and Photo Translation

Point your camera at signs, printed documents, labels, or menus and see the translated text on screen. You can also upload an image from your gallery and translate the content instantly. It is useful when reading instructions, forms, or information in unfamiliar places.

Text Translation

Type or paste text for quick and accurate translation. Automatic language detection makes it easier to move between languages without constant manual changes.

Natural and Context Aware

Literal translations often carry the right meaning but miss the way people actually phrase things. The wording here is closer to how sentences are spoken in everyday life. It makes short exchanges feel smoother and less rigid.

The goal is simple. Make communication easier wherever you are. Traveling abroad, studying, working with international clients, or messaging friends should not feel stressful. AI Translator gives you live translation, voice translation, camera translation, photo translation, and fast text translation in one reliable app.

【 Your Personal AirPods Translator for Live Translation 】

Looking for the perfect AirPod translator? AirTranslator is built to be the ultimate live translator for your Apple earbuds and in-ears. Use your AirPods to translate conversations in real-time, making it the ideal tool for travel and meetings. Our technology is optimized for a smooth AirPods live translation experience, including specialized support for AirPods Pro translation. This is the translator, AirPods users have been waiting for.

▶ Split AirPods – Share one AirPod with your conversation partner. Each person hears their own language!
▶ AirPods + Speaker – You hear your language on AirPods, while the translation plays from your iPhone speaker for your partner.
▶ AirPods + Earpiece – You hear your language on AirPods, and your partner holds the iPhone like on a phone call for a private, quiet translation.


【 Push to Talk ** Press & Speak ** Tap to Talk Mode 】

【 Quick Translations Even Without Headphones 】

AirTranslator works even *without* headphones and enables instant, quick translations on the go! Want to grab a Coffee-to-Go while traveling? You may need a Translation-to-Go for that!


【 Example Use Cases 】

* Share one AirPod each and start a live translation in seconds - perfect as a real time translator when meeting new people.
* Tap-to-talk for quick phrases - use it as your pocket AirPods translator while traveling.
* Hands-free live conversations with AI for seamless communication.
* Supports AirPods Pro 3 and older AirPods models (see below)!

* AirPods 1, 2, 3 & 4

* EarPods, EarBuds, & other wired Headphones

* Works with AirPods Pro and any other Headphones!
* Natural, Hands-Free Conversations in real-time!

* Latest AI Technology for Accurate Translations!

VOICE TRANSLATION IN REAL TIME
Supports speech recognition with real-time translation. View or listen to translated results for natural two-way conversations.

INSTANT CAMERA & IMAGE TRANSLATION
Translate text from photos or imported images. AR Mode displays translations in context, making any printed or on-screen text easier to understand.

CAPTURE WORD TRANSLATION

TEXT TRANSLATION FOR TYPED OR PASTED CONTENT
Quickly translate typed or pasted text, with support for full-page display and easy copying or sharing of the results.

KEYBOARD TRANSLATOR WHILE TYPING IN ANY APP
Translate directly from the keyboard, no app switching needed, making cross-language communication easier.

TRANSLATION HISTORY MANAGEMENT
Automatically saves your translation history. Easily view records by type (translation or conversation), and export, copy, or delete them.

OFFLINE MODE WITH DOWNLOADABLE LANGUAGE PACKS
Download language packs to translate offline, so you can translate anytime, anywhere without network limits, with support for both text and voice translation.

WIDGET QUICK ACCESS TO ALL TRANSLATION MODES
